# SQL cookbook

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/nf/gen_cookbook.py from the rule pack, the tuning catalog and the registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

**77 PostgreSQL rules**, the production FDD engine. Each section is one rule: what it needs, what you can tune, what it returns and the
**exact SQL the app runs**, rendered at the rule's default parameters. Everything is **SI**: °C, Δ°C, Pa, L/s, kW, kWh, % (see
[Units](../units.html)). The [pandas cookbook](pandas-cookbook.html) has the same rules as Python and [parity](parity.html) says where the two
agree.

How the SQL runs: the FDD hook feeds one scoped, SI, wide `history` table (one column per role, one row per equipment per timestamp) to the rule and
reads one row per equipment back. Rules never convert units. A fault must hold for the rule's confirm time before it counts, and a gap longer than one
hour is unknown rather than fault or ok. More in [sql/fdd/README.md](https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/README.md).

Jump to a rule with its id, for example `sql-cookbook.html#fc1`.

## Air handling units {#group-ahu}

AHU / RTU / MAU / DOAS: duct static, supply air, economizer, mixing and mode faults.


### AHU-DUCTHI {#ahu-ducthi}

Duct static pressure high

**Priority** P0 · **Equipment** `ahu` · **Confirm** 5 min · **Parity** [match](parity.html#ahu-ducthi) · [pandas twin](pandas-cookbook.html#ahu-ducthi)

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | NF class | SI unit | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `duct_static` | duct-static-pressure | `discharge-air-pressure-sensor` | Pa | required |
| `duct_static_sp` | duct-static-pressure-sp | `discharge-air-pressure-sp` | Pa | required |
| `fan_cmd` | fan-cmd | `discharge-run-cmd`, `run-cmd` | % | required |
| `fan_status` | fan-status | `discharge-run-sensor`, `run-sensor` | 0/1 | optional |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 5 | 0 | 60 | 5 | min |
| `duct_high_margin` | High margin | 62.21 | 12.442 | 248.84 | 12.442 | Pa |
| `minimum_active_coverage_pct` † | Min active coverage | 5 | 0 | 100 | 1 | % |
| `pressure_on_min` | Pressure-on evidence | 49.768 | 12.442 | 248.84 | 12.442 | Pa |
| `require_operational_gate` † | Require operational gate | 1 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0/1 |
| `startup_delay_min` † | Startup delay | 0 | 0 | 60 | 1 | min |

† informational: this control has no effect in the SQL template.

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`, `fault_pct`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (103 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/ahu_ducthi.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- ahu_ducthi.sql — Duct static pressure high
-- Equation: static > SP + DUCT_HIGH_MARGIN.
-- Gate: fan-on from fan_status then fan_cmd. Missing fan stays NULL
-- (do not ELSE 1). Pressure-on substitutes only when fan proof is absent,
-- never when status/cmd is proven 0 (frozen overnight static).
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    duct_static, duct_static_sp,
    fan_cmd AS fan,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE NULL
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN duct_static IS NULL OR duct_static_sp IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN fan_on = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN fan_on = 1 AND duct_static > duct_static_sp + 62.21 THEN 1
      WHEN fan_on IS NULL
           AND ABS(duct_static) > 49.768
           AND duct_static > duct_static_sp + 62.21 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>

| `sat_dev_err` | SAT deviation | 2.77778 | 0.555556 | 8.33333 | 0.277778 | Δ°C |

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (103 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/ahu_satdev.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- ahu_satdev.sql — SAT deviation from setpoint (fan_running + confirm)
-- Gate: fan-on from fan_status then fan_cmd. Missing fan stays off
-- (do not ELSE 1 / COALESCE to on — that invents on-hours).
-- Quality (#1253): SQL does NOT apply open_fdd.quality OUT_OF_RANGE/sentinel
-- nulling. Pandas SQL parity must use quality=False; run_rule(quality=True) is
-- a different surface.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    sat,
    sat_sp,
    fan_cmd,
    fan_status,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 0
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN sat IS NULL OR sat_sp IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN ABS(sat - sat_sp) > 2.777778 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- ahu_simul.sql — Heating and cooling simultaneous
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    htg_valve_pct AS htg,
    clg_valve_pct AS clg,
    fan_cmd,
    fan_status,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN htg IS NULL OR clg IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN htg > 0.1 AND clg > 0.1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

```sql
      ELSE 0

  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,

        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (

),
lagged AS (

       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,

ranked AS (

final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
```

| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 15 | 0 | 60 | 5 | min |
| `leak_delta` | Leak ΔT | 1.11111 | 0.277778 | 3.33333 | 0.277778 | Δ°C |
| `minimum_active_coverage_pct` † | Min active coverage | 5 | 0 | 100 | 1 | % |
| `require_operational_gate` † | Require operational gate | 1 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0/1 |
| `startup_delay_min` † | Startup delay | 0 | 0 | 60 | 1 | min |

† informational: this control has no effect in the SQL template.

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`, `fault_pct`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (99 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/dmp1_oa_damper_leak.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- dmp1_oa_damper_leak.sql — OA damper leakage
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    oa_t, mat,
    oa_damper_pct AS oa_d,
    fan_cmd,
    fan_status,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN oa_d IS NULL OR oa_t IS NULL OR mat IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN oa_d <= 0.05 AND ABS(mat - oa_t) < 1.111111 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>

```sql
grp AS (
```

```sql
  GROUP BY timestamp_utc

      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history h
  LEFT JOIN wx
    ON h.timestamp_utc = wx.timestamp_utc
),
base AS (

      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN web_oa_t IS NULL OR web_oa_dp IS NULL OR oa_d IS NULL OR clg IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN web_oa_t >= 15.555556 AND web_oa_t < 22.222222 AND web_oa_dp < 15.555556

      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault

    END AS gap_after
  FROM (

      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
```

```sql
),
grp AS (

  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

| `htg_valve_pct` | heating-valve | `hot-water-heat-valve-cmd`, `discharge-hot-water-heat-valve-cmd`, `discharge-steam-heat-valve-cmd` | % | required |
| `fan_status` | fan-status | `discharge-run-sensor`, `run-sensor` | 0/1 | optional |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 10 | 0 | 60 | 5 | min |
| `htg_open_min` | Heating valve open minimum | 0.01 | 0 | 0.5 | 0.01 | fraction (0-1) |
| `minimum_active_coverage_pct` † | Min active coverage | 5 | 0 | 100 | 1 | % |
| `preheat_over` | Preheat over ΔT | 1.22222 | 0.277778 | 4.44444 | 0.055556 | Δ°C |

| `startup_delay_min` † | Startup delay | 0 | 0 | 60 | 1 | min |

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (104 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/econ5_preheat_over.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- econ5_preheat_over.sql — Preheat over-conditioning (matches vibe19 econ5)
-- Target = OAT when OAT > SAT SP; else SAT SP. Fault when preheat exceeds target by ΔT
-- while heating valve is open.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    preheat_leave_t, sat_sp, oa_t,
    COALESCE(htg_valve_pct, 0.0) AS htg,
    fan_cmd,
    fan_status,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN preheat_leave_t IS NULL OR sat_sp IS NULL OR oa_t IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN htg > 0.01 AND (
        (oa_t > sat_sp AND preheat_leave_t - oa_t > 1.222222)
        OR (oa_t < sat_sp AND preheat_leave_t - sat_sp > 1.222222)
      ) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fc1_duct_static_low.sql — FC1 duct static below SP at full fan + confirm
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    duct_static,
    duct_static_sp,
    fan_cmd AS fan_cmd,
        CASE
      WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on,
    -- Match pandas cookbook `_fan()`: prefer fan_status for the "full fan" gate.
    -- Synth-59 AHU_CASE_FC1 has status=1 with cmd=0.6 for most fault hours;
    -- cmd-only gating under-counts (1h vs 40h).
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
      ELSE fan_cmd
    END AS fan_for_hi
  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(mode_stable, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN duct_static IS NOT NULL AND duct_static_sp IS NOT NULL
       AND duct_static < duct_static_sp - 29.8608
       AND fan_for_hi >= 1.0 - 0.13
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
        ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode_stable
  FROM h
) h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
, cov AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    100.0 * AVG(CAST(COALESCE(fan_on, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS cov_pct
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  f.equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  SUM(f.held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.held_seconds), 0.0)
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.held_seconds), 0.0)
  END AS fault_pct
FROM final f
LEFT JOIN cov c ON f.equipment_id = c.equipment_id
GROUP BY f.equipment_id;
```

</details>

† informational: this control has no effect in the SQL template.

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`, `fault_pct`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (129 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/fc10_mat_oa_clg.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fc10_mat_oa_clg.sql — FC10 MAT-OAT delta while cooling + economizing + confirm
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    mat,
    oa_t,
    COALESCE(oa_damper_pct, 0.0) AS oa_damper_pct,
    COALESCE(clg_valve_pct, 0.0) AS clg_valve_pct,
    fan_cmd,
    fan_status,
        CASE
      WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(mode_stable, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN mat IS NOT NULL AND oa_t IS NOT NULL
       AND clg_valve_pct > 0.01 AND oa_damper_pct > 0.9
       AND ABS(mat - oa_t) > SQRT(2.0 * 0.638888889 * 0.638888889)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
        ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode_stable
  FROM h
) h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
, cov AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    100.0 * AVG(CAST(COALESCE(fan_on, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS cov_pct
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  f.equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  SUM(f.held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.held_seconds), 0.0)
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.held_seconds), 0.0)
  END AS fault_pct
FROM final f
LEFT JOIN cov c ON f.equipment_id = c.equipment_id
GROUP BY f.equipment_id;
```

</details>

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (130 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/sat_high_fault.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- sat_high_fault.sql — FC13 SAT above SP at full cooling + confirm (matches cookbook fc13)
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    sat,
    sat_sp,
    COALESCE(clg_valve_pct, 0.0) AS clg_valve_pct,
    COALESCE(oa_damper_pct, 0.0) AS oa_damper_pct,
    fan_cmd,
    fan_status,
        CASE
      WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(mode_stable, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN sat IS NOT NULL AND sat_sp IS NOT NULL
       AND clg_valve_pct > 0.9
       AND sat > sat_sp + 0.638888889
       AND (oa_damper_pct <= 0.05 OR oa_damper_pct > 0.9)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
        ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode_stable
  FROM h
) h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
, cov AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    100.0 * AVG(CAST(COALESCE(fan_on, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS cov_pct
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  f.equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  SUM(f.held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.held_seconds), 0.0)
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.held_seconds), 0.0)
  END AS fault_pct
FROM final f
LEFT JOIN cov c ON f.equipment_id = c.equipment_id
GROUP BY f.equipment_id;
```

</details>

```sql
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(mode_stable, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN mat IS NOT NULL AND oa_t IS NOT NULL AND rat IS NOT NULL
       AND (mat + 0.638888889) < (CASE WHEN rat < oa_t THEN rat - 0.638888889 ELSE oa_t - 0.638888889 END)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
        ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode_stable
  FROM h
) h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
, cov AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    100.0 * AVG(CAST(COALESCE(fan_on, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS cov_pct
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  f.equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  SUM(f.held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.held_seconds), 0.0)
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.held_seconds), 0.0)
  END AS fault_pct
FROM final f
LEFT JOIN cov c ON f.equipment_id = c.equipment_id
GROUP BY f.equipment_id;
```

</details>

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (161 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/fc4_os_hunting.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fc4_os_hunting.sql — PID hunting (operating-state oscillation), GL36 fault 4
-- ΔOS > ΔOSmax during the clock hour: count how many times the AHU *enters* each
-- operating state within the hour and flag the whole hour when any state is
-- entered more than DELTA_OS_MAX times.
-- Operating states: 1 = min OA / heating, 2 = economizer, 3 = mechanical cooling
-- (0 = fan off, not counted).
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    oa_damper_pct AS oa_d,
    clg_valve_pct AS clg,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE fan_cmd
    END AS fan,
    CASE
      WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
),
modes AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    DATE_TRUNC('hour', timestamp_utc) AS clock_hour,
    CASE
      WHEN fan IS NULL OR fan < 0.01 THEN 0
      WHEN clg IS NOT NULL AND clg > 0.1 THEN 3
      WHEN oa_d IS NOT NULL AND oa_d > 0.5 THEN 2
      ELSE 1
    END AS op_mode
  FROM h
),
entries AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    clock_hour,
    op_mode,
    CASE
      WHEN op_mode = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN LAG(op_mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN op_mode <> LAG(op_mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_entry
  FROM modes
),
hourly AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_entry = 1 AND op_mode = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, clock_hour) AS entries_min_oa,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_entry = 1 AND op_mode = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, clock_hour) AS entries_econ,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_entry = 1 AND op_mode = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, clock_hour) AS entries_mech
  FROM entries
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN entries_min_oa > 5 THEN 1
      WHEN entries_econ > 5 THEN 1
      WHEN entries_mech > 5 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM hourly
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 3600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
, cov AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    100.0 * AVG(CAST(COALESCE(fan_on, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS cov_pct
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  f.equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  SUM(f.held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.held_seconds), 0.0)
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.held_seconds), 0.0)
  END AS fault_pct
FROM final f
LEFT JOIN cov c ON f.equipment_id = c.equipment_id
GROUP BY f.equipment_id;
```

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fc5_sat_cold_heating.sql — SAT cold when heating commanded (GL36 D)
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    sat, mat,
    htg_valve_pct AS htg,
    fan_cmd AS fan,
        CASE
      WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,

      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(mode_stable, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN sat IS NULL OR mat IS NULL OR htg IS NULL OR fan IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN fan >= 0.01 AND htg > 0.01
       AND (sat + 0.638888889) <= (mat - 0.638888889 + 0.305555556) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
        ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode_stable
  FROM h
) h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
, cov AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    100.0 * AVG(CAST(COALESCE(fan_on, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS cov_pct
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  f.equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  SUM(f.held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.held_seconds), 0.0)
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.held_seconds), 0.0)
  END AS fault_pct
FROM final f
LEFT JOIN cov c ON f.equipment_id = c.equipment_id
GROUP BY f.equipment_id;
```

| `vav_total_flow` | vav-total-airflow | - | L/s | required |
| `fan_status` | fan-status | `discharge-run-sensor`, `run-sensor` | 0/1 | optional |

**Parameters**

|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|

| `minimum_active_coverage_pct` | Min active coverage | 5 | 0 | 100 | 1 | % |
| `mode_delay_min` | Mode delay after fan-on | 10 | 0 | 60 | 1 | min |
| `oat_rat_delta_min` | Min \|OAT-RAT\| | 2.77778 | 0 | 16.6667 | 0.277778 | °C |
| `require_operational_gate` | Require operational gate | 1 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0/1 |
| `startup_delay_min` | Startup delay | 0 | 0 | 60 | 1 | min |

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (131 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/fc6_oa_frac_mismatch.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fc6_oa_frac_mismatch.sql — Estimated OA fraction mismatch (GL36 fault 6)
-- |RATavg − OATavg| >= ΔTmin AND |estimated OA% − design min OA%| > εF, where
-- design min OA% = MIN_FLOW_DESIGN / total VAV airflow.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    mat, rat, oa_t, vav_total_flow,
    fan_cmd AS fan,
        CASE
      WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(mode_stable, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN mat IS NULL OR rat IS NULL OR oa_t IS NULL OR fan IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN vav_total_flow IS NULL OR vav_total_flow <= 0.0 THEN 0
      WHEN fan < 0.01 THEN 0
      WHEN ABS(rat - oa_t) < 2.777777778 THEN 0
      WHEN ABS((mat - rat) / NULLIF(oa_t - rat, 0)
               - 2359.735 / NULLIF(vav_total_flow, 0)) > 0.15 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
        ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode_stable
  FROM h
) h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
, cov AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    100.0 * AVG(CAST(COALESCE(fan_on, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS cov_pct
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  f.equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  SUM(f.held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.held_seconds), 0.0)
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.held_seconds), 0.0)
  END AS fault_pct
FROM final f
LEFT JOIN cov c ON f.equipment_id = c.equipment_id
GROUP BY f.equipment_id;
```

</details>

```sql
        CASE
      WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(mode_stable, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN oa_t IS NOT NULL AND sat_sp IS NOT NULL
       AND oa_damper_pct > 0.05 AND clg_valve_pct < 0.1
       AND (oa_t - 0.638889) > (sat_sp - 0.305555556 + 0.638889)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 1) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
        PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
        ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode_stable
  FROM h
) h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
, cov AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    100.0 * AVG(CAST(COALESCE(fan_on, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS cov_pct
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  f.equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  SUM(f.held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.held_seconds), 0.0)
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.held_seconds), 0.0)
  END AS fault_pct
FROM final f
LEFT JOIN cov c ON f.equipment_id = c.equipment_id
GROUP BY f.equipment_id;
```

</details>

### SCHED-1 {#sched-1}

Excess / wasted unoccupied fan runtime when the zone is already in the comfort band (optimal-start / schedule misconfig signal). Without zone_t, falls back to unoccupied + fan_on (pandas sched1 base).

**Priority** P0 · **Equipment** `ahu`, `zone_other` · **Confirm** 30 min · **Parity** [match](parity.html#sched-1) · [pandas twin](pandas-cookbook.html#sched-1)

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | NF class | SI unit | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `occ_mode` | occupied | `occupied-sensor` | 0/1 | required |
| `fan_status` | fan-status | `discharge-run-sensor`, `run-sensor` | 0/1 | required |
| `zone_t` | zone-air-temp | `zone-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `comfort_high` | Zone comfort high | 23.8889 | 12.7778 | 32.2222 | 0.277778 | °C |
| `comfort_low` | Zone comfort low | 21.1111 | 10 | 26.6667 | 0.277778 | °C |
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 30 | 0 | 60 | 5 | min |

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`, `fault_pct`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (101 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/sched1_unoccupied_runtime.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- sched1_unoccupied_runtime.sql — Excess / wasted unoccupied runtime
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): zone_t and the ZONE_T_LO / ZONE_T_HI comfort band are °C.
-- Pandas sched1: unoccupied & fan_on; when zone_t mapped, also require comfort band
-- (zone already satisfied → optimal-start / bad schedule signal).
-- When zone_t is absent from history, the runner injects NULL zone_t (optional role)
-- so behavior matches pandas “no zone → base only”.
-- Portable occupancy: literal 'unoccupied' OR numeric/boolean falsey (0 / 0.0 / false).
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
        CAST(CASE
          WHEN occ_mode IS NULL OR fan_status IS NULL THEN 0
          WHEN fan_status > 0.5
            AND (
              LOWER(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) IN
                ('unoccupied','unocc','off','false','night','standby','setback','no')
              OR (
                fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) IS NOT NULL
                AND fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) <= 0.05
              )
            )
            AND (
              zone_t IS NULL
              OR (zone_t >= 21.111111 AND zone_t <= 23.888889)
            )
          THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM history
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `always_on_pct` | Always-on fraction | 0.95 | 0.8 | 1 | 0.01 | fraction (0-1) |
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 60 | 0 | 60 | 5 | min |

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`, `fault_pct`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (117 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/sched247_always_on.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- sched247_always_on.sql — Always-on fan or pump runtime
-- Unit-free: ALWAYS_ON_PCT is a fraction of run status samples (unchanged by SI storage).
-- Pandas `_sched247`: ranked proof (status > command), then FAULT only when
-- mean(on) >= always_on_pct over the whole analysis window. Confirmed hours
-- are the on-mask after that gate (not a streak-only screen).
-- Pressure is not used for the FAULT mask (4.3 migration).
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    fan_status,
    pump_status,
    chiller_status,
    fan_cmd AS fan
  FROM history
),
proof AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN pump_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN pump_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chiller_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chiller_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan >= 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS on_bit
  FROM h
),
win AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    on_bit,
    AVG(CAST(on_bit AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS on_frac
  FROM proof
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN on_frac >= 0.95 AND on_bit = 1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM win
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 3600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- trim1_duct_static.sql — Duct static trim advisory
-- Pandas trim1: high actual duct static + low VAV pressure-request sum.
-- Prefer duct_static (measured); fall back to duct_static_sp when only SP is mapped.
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(duct_static, duct_static_sp) IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(duct_static, duct_static_sp) > 335.934
       AND COALESCE(static_reset_request, 0) <= 1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    fan_cmd,
    fan_status,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

```sql
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,

      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,

      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc

),
final AS (
```

### VAV-1 {#vav-1}

Zone comfort band during occupied hours when occupancy is set; unoccupied setback is VAV-2; no occupancy model or schedule → NOT_ASSESSED_NO_OCCUPANCY

**Priority** P0 · **Equipment** `vav`, `zone_other`, `heatpump`, `baseboard` · **Confirm** 15 min · **Parity** [match](parity.html#vav-1) · [pandas twin](pandas-cookbook.html#vav-1)

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 15 | 0 | 60 | 5 | min |
| `minimum_active_coverage_pct` † | Min active coverage | 5 | 0 | 100 | 1 | % |
| `require_occupied` | Require occupied | 1 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0/1 |
| `require_operational_gate` † | Require operational gate | 1 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0/1 |
| `startup_delay_min` † | Startup delay | 0 | 0 | 60 | 1 | min |
| `zone_t_hi` | Zone high | 23.8889 | 22.2222 | 29.4444 | 0.277778 | °C |
| `zone_t_lo` | Zone low | 21.1111 | 12.7778 | 22.2222 | 0.277778 | °C |

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (109 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/vav1_comfort_fault.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- vav1_comfort_fault.sql — zone comfort band with confirm window (Open-FDD parity)
-- When occ_mode is present, require_occupied (default 1) scores the band only
-- while occupied. The rule runner synthesizes occ_mode from the saved Overview
-- calendar (session occupancy_schedule) when no modeled occ_mode exists.
-- With neither signal, the product path reports NOT_ASSESSED_NO_OCCUPANCY (0 fault
-- seconds). Unoccupied setback stays on VAV-2.
-- OFDD-065: do not reference fan_cmd here. Zone-only parquet schemas
-- often lack fan_cmd; DataFusion then schema-errors → SKIPPED_MISSING_ROLES.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    zone_t,
    occ_mode,
    CAST(CASE WHEN zone_t < 21.111111111 OR zone_t > 23.888888889 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS band_fault
  FROM history
  WHERE zone_t IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5
       AND occ_mode IS NOT NULL
       AND (
         LOWER(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) IN
           ('unoccupied','unocc','off','false','night','standby','setback','no')
         OR (
           fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) IS NOT NULL
           AND fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) <= 0.05
         )
       )
      THEN 0
      ELSE band_fault
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- vav2_night_setback.sql — unoccupied zone stays above heating setback
-- Occupied hours do not latch. Missing occ_mode → no unoccupied proof (no fault).
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    zone_t,
    occ_mode,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN occ_mode IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN (
        LOWER(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) IN
          ('unoccupied','unocc','off','false','night','standby','setback','0','0.0','no')
        OR (
          fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) IS NOT NULL
          AND fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) <= 0.05
        )
      )
       AND zone_t IS NOT NULL AND zone_t > 20 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM history
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM h src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
```

<summary>SQL at defaults (100 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/vav3_excessive_reheat.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- vav3_excessive_reheat.sql — Excessive reheat during warm weather
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    oa_t, zone_flow,
    reheat_valve_pct AS rh,
    fan_cmd,
    fan_status,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on

  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN oa_t IS NULL OR rh IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(zone_flow, 0) > 11.798675
       AND oa_t > 25.555555556 AND rh > 0.52 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```
