```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- vav4_damper_full_open.sql — sequential sustain then confirm (pandas vav4).
-- Stage 1: air-on and damper > FULL_OPEN for SUSTAIN_HOURS of eligible elapsed time.
-- Stage 2: confirm that sustained mask for CONFIRM_SECONDS (not the max of the two).
-- Gaps longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS are unknown and break both streaks.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    zone_flow,
    damper_pct AS dmp,
    fan_cmd,
    fan_status,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN zone_flow IS NOT NULL AND zone_flow > 11.798675 THEN 1
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
),
cond AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN dmp IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN COALESCE(zone_flow, 0) > 11.798675 AND dmp > 0.975 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS cond_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM cond src
  ) stepped
),
lagged1 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN cond_fault = LAG(cond_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new1
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp1 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new1) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak1
  FROM lagged1
),
sustained AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN cond_fault = 1
       AND SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
         PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak1 ORDER BY timestamp_utc
         ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
       ) >= (1.5 * 3600.0)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS sustained_fault
  FROM grp1
),
lagged2 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN sustained_fault = LAG(sustained_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new2
  FROM sustained
),
grp2 AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new2) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak2
  FROM lagged2
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN sustained_fault = 1
       AND SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
         PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak2 ORDER BY timestamp_utc
         ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
       ) >= 900
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS confirmed
  FROM grp2
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>

| `zone_flow` | zone-airflow | `discharge-air-flow-sensor`, `air-flow-sensor` | L/s | required |
| `min_flow_sp` | min-flow-sp | - | L/s | optional |
| `fan_status` | fan-status | `discharge-run-sensor`, `run-sensor` | 0/1 | optional |
| `fan_cmd` | fan-cmd | `discharge-run-cmd`, `run-cmd` | % | optional |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 15 | 0 | 60 | 5 | min |
| `fixed_flow_hours` | Fixed-flow rolling window | 1 | 0.25 | 6 | 0.25 | h |
| `fixed_flow_max_std` | Fixed-flow max std | 7.0792 | 0.471947 | 37.7558 | 0.471947 | L/s |
| `fixed_flow_min_mean` | Fixed-flow min mean | 94.3894 | 23.5973 | 943.894 | 4.71947 | L/s |
| `flow_on_min` | Airflow-on min | 11.7987 | 0 | 94.3894 | 2.35974 | L/s |
| `high_min_flow_sp` | High min-flow SP | 117.987 | 23.5973 | 943.894 | 4.71947 | L/s |
| `minimum_active_coverage_pct` † | Min active coverage | 5 | 0 | 100 | 1 | % |
| `require_operational_gate` † | Require operational gate | 1 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0/1 |

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (125 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/vav7_min_airflow.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- vav7_min_airflow.sql — three pandas branches: under-min, fixed-high flow, high min SP.
-- Rolling windows use poll-derived 12 (1h sample count), matching pandas.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    zone_flow,
    min_flow_sp,
    fan_cmd,
    fan_status,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN zone_flow IS NOT NULL AND zone_flow > 11.798675 THEN 1
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
),
rolled AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    STDDEV_SAMP(zone_flow) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS roll_std,
    AVG(zone_flow) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS roll_mean,
    COUNT(zone_flow) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS roll_n
  FROM h
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN zone_flow IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN min_flow_sp IS NOT NULL AND zone_flow > 11.798675 AND zone_flow < min_flow_sp THEN 1
      WHEN roll_n >= 6
           AND zone_flow IS NOT NULL
           AND roll_std < 7.079205
           AND roll_mean > 94.3894 THEN 1
      WHEN min_flow_sp IS NOT NULL
           AND roll_n >= 6
           AND min_flow_sp > 117.98675
           AND roll_std < 7.079205 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM rolled
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>

```sql
      THEN 0.0

    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (

        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (

        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING

),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
```

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
```

```sql
-- fcu_clg_coil.sql — first-class FCU screening rule
WITH normalized AS (

  FROM normalized
), elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
), grouped AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(is_new_streak) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM ranked
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 15 | 0 | 120 | 1 | min |
| `position_error` | Position error | 0.15 | 0.05 | 0.5 | 0.05 | fraction (0-1) |

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`, `fault_pct`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (72 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/fcu_damper_pos.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fcu_damper_pos.sql — first-class FCU screening rule
WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, sat, zone_t, zone_co2,
    htg_valve_pct AS htg,
    clg_valve_pct AS clg,
    damper_cmd AS dcmd,
    damper_pct AS dpos,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 0
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
), base AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE WHEN fan_on = 1 AND dcmd IS NOT NULL AND dpos IS NOT NULL AND dcmd >= 0.15 AND dcmd - dpos > 0.15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM normalized
), elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
), grouped AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(is_new_streak) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM ranked
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cooling_sp` | cooling-sp | `zone-air-temp-occ-cooling-sp` | °C | required |
| `heating_sp` | heating-sp | `zone-air-temp-occ-heating-sp` | °C | required |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` † | Fault confirm delay | 0 | 0 | 120 | 1 | min |
| `deadband` | Minimum deadband | 1 | 0 | 5 | 0.1 | °C |

† informational: this control has no effect in the SQL template.

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`, `fault_pct`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (42 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/fcu_deadband.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- FCU-DEADBAND — pass-through FCU setpoints remain site-native Celsius.
-- Duration is the eligible forward delta, not a row count times poll.
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    cooling_sp,
    heating_sp,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    cooling_sp,
    heating_sp,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN cooling_sp IS NOT NULL AND heating_sp IS NOT NULL
     AND cooling_sp - heating_sp < 1
    THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0
  END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE
    WHEN cooling_sp IS NOT NULL AND heating_sp IS NOT NULL
     AND cooling_sp - heating_sp < 1
    THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0
  END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

### FCU-MODE-CYCLE {#fcu-mode-cycle}

Four or more heat/cool valve mode changes in window

**Priority** P1 · **Equipment** `zone_other`, `general`, `ahu` · **Confirm** immediate · **Parity** [known divergence](parity.html#fcu-mode-cycle) · [pandas twin](pandas-cookbook.html#fcu-mode-cycle)

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | NF class | SI unit | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `htg_valve_pct` | heating-valve | `hot-water-heat-valve-cmd`, `discharge-hot-water-heat-valve-cmd`, `discharge-steam-heat-valve-cmd` | % | required |
| `clg_valve_pct` | cooling-valve | `chilled-water-cool-valve-cmd`, `discharge-chilled-water-cool-valve-cmd` | % | required |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` † | Fault confirm delay | 0 | 0 | 120 | 1 | min |
| `mode_changes` | Mode changes | 4 | 1 | 20 | 1 | count |
| `mode_valve_min` | Active valve threshold | 0.1 | 0 | 0.5 | 0.05 | fraction (0-1) |

† informational: this control has no effect in the SQL template.

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`, `fault_pct`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (57 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/fcu_mode_cycle.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- FCU-MODE-CYCLE — cumulative heat/cool mode transitions in the analysis window.
-- Hours are eligible forward deltas after the change count reaches MODE_CHANGES.
WITH modes AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CASE
      WHEN clg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL AND clg_valve_pct > 0.1 THEN -1
      WHEN htg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL AND htg_valve_pct > 0.1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode
  FROM history
),
active_modes AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, mode
  FROM modes
  WHERE mode <> 0
),
changes AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    mode,
    CASE
      WHEN LAG(mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) IS NOT NULL
       AND mode <> LAG(mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS changed,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM active_modes
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    SUM(changed) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS change_count,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM changes
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN change_count >= 4 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN change_count >= 4 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM cumulative
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | NF class | SI unit | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `zone_air_temp_sp` | zone-air-temp-sp | `zone-air-temp-effective-sp` | °C | required |
| `zone_t` | zone-air-temp | `zone-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` † | Fault confirm delay | 0 | 0 | 120 | 1 | min |
| `null_fraction` | Null fraction | 0.9 | 0.5 | 1 | 0.05 | fraction (0-1) |

† informational: this control has no effect in the SQL template.

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`, `fault_pct`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (55 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/fcu_sensor_null.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- FCU-SENSOR-NULL — own zone setpoint exists while a mapped zone sensor is predominantly null.
-- The runner rewrites this file to zero hours when zone_t is absent from history.
-- Null time and eligible time are eligible forward deltas. A long gap is unknown.
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_air_temp_sp,
    zone_t,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_air_temp_sp,
    zone_t,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
),
coverage AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN zone_air_temp_sp IS NOT NULL THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) AS eligible_seconds,
    SUM(CASE
      WHEN zone_air_temp_sp IS NOT NULL AND zone_t IS NULL THEN held_seconds
      ELSE 0.0
    END) AS null_seconds
  FROM held
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN eligible_seconds > 0.0
     AND null_seconds / eligible_seconds >= 0.9
    THEN null_seconds / 3600.0
    ELSE 0.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  eligible_seconds / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  CASE
    WHEN eligible_seconds > 0.0
     AND null_seconds / eligible_seconds >= 0.9
    THEN 100.0 * null_seconds / eligible_seconds
    ELSE 0.0
  END AS fault_pct
FROM coverage;
```

</details>

<summary>SQL at defaults (72 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/fcu_valve_pass_htg.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fcu_valve_pass_htg.sql — first-class FCU screening rule
WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, sat, zone_t, zone_co2,
    htg_valve_pct AS htg,
    clg_valve_pct AS clg,
    damper_cmd AS dcmd,
    damper_pct AS dpos,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 0
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
), base AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE WHEN sat IS NOT NULL AND zone_t IS NOT NULL AND fan_on = 1 AND htg <= 0.05 AND clg <= 0.05 AND sat - zone_t > 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM normalized
), elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
), grouped AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(is_new_streak) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM ranked
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- chw1_low_dt.sql — Low chilled-water ΔT
-- Operational proof required: status / current / power / flow / pump cmd.
-- Missing proof → 0 fault hours (pandas twin returns SKIPPED_MISSING_ROLES).
-- Proven off (zeros) → 0 fault hours.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    chw_supply_t, chw_return_t,
    chw_pump_cmd AS pump,
    chiller_status,
    chiller_current,
    chiller_amps,
    chiller_power,
    chw_flow,
    pump_status
  FROM history
),
proof AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN pump_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN pump_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chiller_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chiller_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chiller_current IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chiller_current > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chiller_amps IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chiller_amps > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chiller_power IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chiller_power > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chw_flow IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chw_flow > 0.0630902 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN pump IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN pump > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE NULL
    END AS proof_on
  FROM h
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN chw_supply_t IS NULL OR chw_return_t IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN proof_on IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN proof_on = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN (chw_return_t - chw_supply_t) < 2.222222 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM proof
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

```sql
FROM final
```

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | NF class | SI unit | Needed |

| `chiller_cmd` | chiller-cmd | - | % | optional |

| `building_zone_load_satisfied` | building-zone-load-satisfied | - | 0/1 | optional |
| `building_ahu_load_satisfied` | building-ahu-load-satisfied | - | 0/1 | optional |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 30 | 0 | 60 | 5 | min |
| `load_sat_hi` | Load satisfaction high (no-load fault) | 0.5 | 0 | 1 | 0.05 | fraction (0-1) |
| `minimum_active_coverage_pct` † | Min active coverage | 5 | 0 | 100 | 1 | % |
| `require_operational_gate` † | Require operational gate | 1 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0/1 |
| `startup_delay_min` † | Startup delay | 0 | 0 | 60 | 1 | min |

† informational: this control has no effect in the SQL template.

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`, `fault_pct`, `status`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (128 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/chw_noload_1.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- chw_noload_1.sql — Chiller running with no building load
-- When both zone and AHU load-satisfied flags are null, emit
-- SKIPPED_MISSING_ROLES (do not PASS 0 h). Prefer load_satisfaction
-- enrichment pandas uses when those columns are mapped.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    chiller_status,
    chiller_cmd,
    chw_pump_status,
    chw_pump_cmd AS pump_cmd,
    building_zone_load_satisfied,
    building_ahu_load_satisfied,
    CASE
      WHEN building_zone_load_satisfied IS NOT NULL
        OR building_ahu_load_satisfied IS NOT NULL THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS sat_present,
    COALESCE(building_zone_load_satisfied, building_ahu_load_satisfied) AS load_sat
  FROM history
),
proof AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    sat_present,
    load_sat,
    CASE
      WHEN chiller_status IS NULL AND chiller_cmd IS NULL
           AND chw_pump_status IS NULL AND pump_cmd IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN COALESCE(chiller_status, 0) > 0.05 THEN 1
      WHEN COALESCE(chiller_cmd, 0) > 0.05 THEN 1
      WHEN COALESCE(chw_pump_status, 0) > 0.05 THEN 1
      WHEN COALESCE(pump_cmd, 0) > 0.05 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS running
  FROM h
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    sat_present,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN sat_present = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN running IS NULL OR load_sat IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN running = 1 AND load_sat > 0.5 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM proof
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    sat_present,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN MAX(sat_present) = 0 THEN 'SKIPPED_MISSING_ROLES'
    WHEN SUM(confirmed) > 0 THEN 'FAULT'
    ELSE 'PASS'
  END AS status
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>

<summary>SQL at defaults (103 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/trim4_chw_reset.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- trim4_chw_reset.sql — CHW plant reset advisory
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    chw_supply_t,
    chw_reset_request_sum,
    pump_status,
    chiller_status,
    chw_flow,
    chw_pump_cmd,
    CASE
      WHEN pump_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN pump_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chiller_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chiller_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chw_flow IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chw_flow > 0.0630902 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chw_pump_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chw_pump_cmd > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 0
    END AS proof_on
  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(proof_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN chw_supply_t IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN chw_supply_t < 7.222222
       AND COALESCE(chw_reset_request_sum, 0) <= 1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
```

```sql
-- hp1_discharge_cold.sql — Discharge cold when heating
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,

    sat, zone_t,
    fan_cmd AS fan,

    CASE

      ELSE 1
    END AS proof_on

),
base AS (

    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(proof_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN sat IS NULL OR zone_t IS NULL OR fan IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN fan >= 0.05 AND zone_t < 20.555556 AND sat < 29.444444 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed

),
final AS (

    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
```

|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (57 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/util_interval_fault.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- util_interval_fault.sql — BAS 15m vs utility interval (rolling MAE proxy)
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): energy is kWh (canonical interval_energy); UTIL_INTERVAL_MAE is kWh.
WITH bas_raw AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    kwh,
    electric_kw,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE kwh IS NOT NULL OR electric_kw IS NOT NULL
),
bas AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    COALESCE(
      CAST(kwh AS DOUBLE PRECISION),
      CASE
        WHEN dt_seconds > 0.0 AND dt_seconds <= (1 * 3600.0)
        THEN CAST(electric_kw AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * dt_seconds / 3600.0
        ELSE 0.0
      END
    ) AS bas_kwh
  FROM bas_raw
),
util AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(kwh AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS util_kwh
  FROM utility_interval
  WHERE kwh IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    b.timestamp_utc,
    ABS(COALESCE(b.bas_kwh, 0.0) - COALESCE(u.util_kwh, 0.0)) AS abs_err
  FROM bas b
  INNER JOIN util u ON b.timestamp_utc = u.timestamp_utc
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
  AVG(abs_err) AS mae
  FROM joined
)
SELECT
  '__UTIL_INTERVAL__' AS equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM util) = 0 THEN 0.0
    WHEN mae > 5 THEN 720.0
    ELSE 0.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS covered_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS fault_pct
FROM agg;
```

</details>


### UTIL-MONTHLY {#util-monthly}

BAS monthly kWh vs utility monthly bills (% deviation)

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | NF class | SI unit | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kwh` | electric-energy | - | kWh | optional |
| `electric_kw` | electric-power | `total-active-ac-elec-power-sensor` | kW | optional |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` † | Fault confirm delay | 0 | 0 | 120 | 1 | min |
| `util_pct_err` | Monthly kWh deviation | 10 | 2 | 50 | 1 | % |

† informational: this control has no effect in the SQL template.

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`, `fault_pct`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (59 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/util_monthly_fault.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- util_monthly_fault.sql — BAS monthly kWh vs utility monthly bills (% deviation)
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): energy is kWh; UTIL_PCT_ERR is a percent of utility kWh.
WITH bas_raw AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    kwh,
    electric_kw,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE kwh IS NOT NULL OR electric_kw IS NOT NULL
),
bas_monthly AS (
  SELECT
    to_char(timestamp_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM') AS billing_period,
    SUM(
      COALESCE(
        CAST(kwh AS DOUBLE PRECISION),
        CASE
          WHEN dt_seconds > 0.0 AND dt_seconds <= (1 * 3600.0)
          THEN CAST(electric_kw AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * dt_seconds / 3600.0
          ELSE 0.0
        END,
        0.0
      )
    ) AS bas_kwh
  FROM bas_raw
  GROUP BY 1
),
util AS (
  SELECT
    billing_period,
    CAST(kwh AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS util_kwh
  FROM utility_monthly
  WHERE kwh IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    u.billing_period,
    u.util_kwh,
    COALESCE(b.bas_kwh, 0.0) AS bas_kwh,
    CASE
      WHEN u.util_kwh IS NULL OR u.util_kwh <= 0 THEN 0
      WHEN ABS(COALESCE(b.bas_kwh, 0.0) - u.util_kwh) / u.util_kwh * 100.0 > 10
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS raw_fault
  FROM util u
  LEFT JOIN bas_monthly b ON b.billing_period = u.billing_period
)
SELECT
  '__UTIL_MONTHLY__' AS equipment_id,
  CAST(SUM(raw_fault) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 720.0 AS fault_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS covered_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS fault_pct
FROM joined;
```

</details>

**Priority** P0 · **Equipment** `ahu`, `vav`, `zone_other`, `chiller`, `boiler`, `heatpump` · **Confirm** immediate · **Parity** [match](parity.html#pid-hunt-1) · [pandas twin](pandas-cookbook.html#pid-hunt-1)

| `htg_valve_pct` | heating-valve | `hot-water-heat-valve-cmd`, `discharge-hot-water-heat-valve-cmd`, `discharge-steam-heat-valve-cmd` | % | optional |

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|

| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 0 | 0 | 60 | 5 | min |
| `minimum_active_coverage_pct` † | Min active coverage | 5 | 0 | 100 | 1 | % |
| `minimum_coverage_pct` | Min window sample coverage | 80 | 50 | 100 | 5 | % |
| `minimum_equivalent_cycles` | Min equivalent cycles | 2.5 | 0.5 | 10 | 0.5 | count |
| `minimum_reversals` | Min direction reversals | 4 | 1 | 20 | 1 | count |
| `minimum_span_pct` | Minimum observed span | 20 | 5 | 100 | 5 | % |
| `require_operational_gate` † | Require operational gate | 1 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0/1 |
| `startup_delay_min` † | Startup delay | 0 | 0 | 60 | 1 | min |
| `total_variation_fault_pct` | Total variation fault threshold | 500 | 50 | 2000 | 50 | % |
| `window_hours` | Hunting lookback window | 1 | 0.25 | 4 | 0.25 | h |

† informational: this control has no effect in the SQL template.

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`, `fault_pct`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (187 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/pid_hunt_1.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- pid_hunt_1.sql — Suspected control-output hunting (rolling 1h metrics)
-- Matches pandas hunting_fault_mask: TV / span / cycles / reversals over
-- WINDOW_HOURS. The detection window is still a row frame (WINDOW_ROWS).
-- Fault hours integrate eligible forward deltas and do not add a phantom
-- interval after the last sample. 12 / 11
-- are derived from WINDOW_HOURS + POLL_SECONDS (literal ROWS bounds).
-- Inputs are fractions 0-1 (input_contract.sql); the control output is converted to percent points (x 100)
-- exactly here, once, because the *_PCT parameters (span, deadband, total variation) are percent points.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CASE
      WHEN oa_damper_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
        oa_damper_pct * 100.0
      WHEN clg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
        clg_valve_pct * 100.0
      WHEN htg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
        htg_valve_pct * 100.0
      WHEN damper_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
        damper_pct * 100.0
      ELSE NULL
    END AS out_pct,
    LAG(
      CASE
        WHEN oa_damper_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
          oa_damper_pct * 100.0
        WHEN clg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
          clg_valve_pct * 100.0
        WHEN htg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
          htg_valve_pct * 100.0
        WHEN damper_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
          damper_pct * 100.0
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) AS prev_out,
    COALESCE(loop_enabled, 1.0) AS loop_on,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
),
deltas AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN prev_out IS NULL OR out_pct IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN ABS(out_pct - prev_out) >= 1 THEN out_pct - prev_out
      ELSE 0.0
    END AS sig_delta
  FROM h
),
steps AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN sig_delta IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE ABS(sig_delta)
    END AS abs_step,
    CASE
      WHEN sig_delta IS NULL OR sig_delta = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN LAG(sig_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN LAG(sig_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN sig_delta * LAG(sig_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) < 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS reversal_event
  FROM deltas
),
win AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    out_pct,
    fan_on,
    loop_on,
    COUNT(out_pct) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS n_samples,
    SUM(abs_step) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS tv,
    MAX(out_pct) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )
      - MIN(out_pct) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS span,
    SUM(reversal_event) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS reversals
  FROM steps
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN loop_on IS NOT NULL AND loop_on <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN out_pct IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN n_samples < CAST(CEIL(12 * 80 / 100.0) AS INT) THEN 0
      WHEN span < 20 THEN 0
      WHEN tv < 500 THEN 0
      WHEN span <= 0 THEN 0
      WHEN (tv / (2.0 * NULLIF(span, 0))) < 2.5 THEN 0
      WHEN reversals < 4 THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM win
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>


### SV-FLATLINE {#sv-flatline}

Sensor flatline (stuck)

**Priority** P0 · **Equipment** `ahu`, `vav`, `chiller`, `boiler`, `weather`, `zone_other`, `heatpump` · **Confirm** 5 min · **Parity** [match](parity.html#sv-flatline) · [pandas twin](pandas-cookbook.html#sv-flatline)

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | NF class | SI unit | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `oa_t` | outside-air-temp | `outside-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |
| `mat` | mixed-air-temp | `mixed-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |
| `zone_t` | zone-air-temp | `zone-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |
| `rat` | return-air-temp | `return-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |
| `sat` | discharge-air-temp | `discharge-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |
| `chw_supply_t` | chilled-water-supply-temp | - | °C | optional |
| `chw_return_t` | chilled-water-return-temp | - | °C | optional |
| `hw_supply_t` | hot-water-supply-temp | - | °C | optional |
| `hw_return_t` | hot-water-return-temp | - | °C | optional |
| `oa_h` | outside-air-humidity | `outside-air-humidity-sensor` | % | optional |
| `ra_h` | return-air-humidity | `return-air-humidity-sensor` | % | optional |
| `zone_rh` | zone-air-humidity | `zone-air-humidity-sensor` | % | optional |
| `ma_h` | mixed-air-humidity | `mixed-air-humidity-sensor` | % | optional |
| `sa_h` | supply-air-humidity | `discharge-air-humidity-sensor` | % | optional |
| `fan_status` | fan-status | `discharge-run-sensor`, `run-sensor` | 0/1 | optional |
| `fan_cmd` | fan-cmd | `discharge-run-cmd`, `run-cmd` | % | optional |
| `pump_status` | pump-status | - | 0/1 | optional |
| `chw_pump_cmd` | chw-pump-cmd | - | % | optional |
| `chiller_status` | chiller-status | - | 0/1 | optional |
| `zone_flow` | zone-airflow | `discharge-air-flow-sensor`, `air-flow-sensor` | L/s | optional |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 5 | 0 | 60 | 5 | min |
| `flatline_hours` | Flatline window | 1 | 0.25 | 12 | 0.25 | h |
| `flatline_tol` | Flatline tolerance | 0.055556 | 0.011111 | 0.555556 | 0.011111 | °C |
| `max_silence_hours` | Max sensor silence | 0.5 | 0.25 | 12 | 0.25 | h |
| `minimum_active_coverage_pct` † | Min active coverage | 5 | 0 | 100 | 1 | % |
| `require_operational_gate` † | Require operational gate | 1 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0/1 |
| `startup_delay_min` † | Startup delay | 0 | 0 | 60 | 1 | min |

† informational: this control has no effect in the SQL template.

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `series_id`, `sensor_role`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (155 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/sv_flatline.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
WITH base_proof AS (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN h.fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.zone_flow IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.zone_flow > 23.597350 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.pump_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.pump_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.chw_pump_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.chw_pump_cmd > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.chiller_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.chiller_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1 END AS energized
  FROM history h
),
base_history AS (
  SELECT base_proof.*,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
sensor_rows AS (
  SELECT s.equipment_id, s.series_id, s.sensor_role, s.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    COALESCE(bh.energized, 1) AS energized,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    CASE WHEN s.sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'zone_rh', 'ma_h', 'sa_h')
      THEN fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) ELSE NULL END AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN base_history bh
    ON bh.equipment_id = s.equipment_id AND bh.timestamp_utc = s.timestamp_utc
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
),
prior AS (
  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch
  FROM sensor_rows
),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment
  FROM prior
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM prior_groups WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT valid.*,
    MIN(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_first_epoch,
    MIN(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_min,
    MAX(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_max,
    FIRST_VALUE(previous_value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_first_prev_value,
    FIRST_VALUE(previous_epoch) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_first_prev_epoch
  FROM valid
),
segments0 AS (
  SELECT windowed.*,
    MIN(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment) AS segment_start_epoch
  FROM windowed
),
elapsed_window AS (
  SELECT segments0.*,
    CASE WHEN window_first_epoch > epoch_seconds - 3600
           AND window_first_prev_epoch <= epoch_seconds - 3600
           AND window_first_prev_epoch >= segment_start_epoch
           AND window_first_prev_value < window_min
         THEN window_first_prev_value ELSE window_min END AS elapsed_window_min,
    CASE WHEN window_first_epoch > epoch_seconds - 3600
           AND window_first_prev_epoch <= epoch_seconds - 3600
           AND window_first_prev_epoch >= segment_start_epoch
           AND window_first_prev_value > window_max
         THEN window_first_prev_value ELSE window_max END AS elapsed_window_max
  FROM segments0
),
signals AS (
  SELECT elapsed_window.*,
    CASE WHEN next_epoch IS NULL OR next_epoch <= epoch_seconds THEN 0.0
         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS dt_seconds,
    CAST(CASE WHEN (((segment_start_epoch <= epoch_seconds - 3600) AND (elapsed_window_max - elapsed_window_min <= CASE WHEN sensor_role IN ('oa_h','ra_h','zone_rh','ma_h','sa_h') THEN 0.1 ELSE 0.055556 END) AND energized = 1)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM elapsed_window
),
segments AS (
  SELECT signals.*,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds <= 0 THEN 0.0
         WHEN dt_seconds < 1800 THEN dt_seconds
         ELSE 1800 END AS normal_seconds,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds > 1800
         THEN dt_seconds - 1800 ELSE 0.0 END AS silence_seconds
  FROM signals
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_raw_fault
  FROM segments
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_group
  FROM lagged segments
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT streak_groups.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 THEN normal_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment, streak_group
      ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS fault_streak_seconds
  FROM streak_groups
),
confirmed_rows AS (
  SELECT streaks.*,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND fault_streak_seconds >= 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS normal_confirmed
  FROM streaks
),
final AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch,
    normal_confirmed AS confirmed, normal_seconds AS held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE normal_seconds > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role,
    epoch_seconds + 1800 AS segment_epoch,
    1 AS confirmed, silence_seconds AS held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE silence_seconds > 0
),
scored AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role,
    SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
    SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
)
SELECT ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id, ss.sensor_role,
  COALESCE(scored.fault_hours, 0.0) AS fault_hours,
  COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) AS covered_hours
FROM sensor_series ss
LEFT JOIN scored USING (equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role)
ORDER BY ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id;
```

</details>


### SV-RANGE {#sv-range}

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (131 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/sv_range.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
WITH base_proof AS (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN h.fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.zone_flow IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.zone_flow > 23.597350 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.pump_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.pump_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.chw_pump_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.chw_pump_cmd > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.chiller_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.chiller_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1 END AS energized
  FROM history h
),
base_history AS (
  SELECT base_proof.*,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
sensor_rows AS (
  SELECT s.equipment_id, s.series_id, s.sensor_role, s.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    COALESCE(bh.energized, 1) AS energized,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    CASE WHEN s.sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'zone_rh', 'ma_h', 'sa_h', 'duct_static')
      THEN fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) ELSE NULL END AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN base_history bh
    ON bh.equipment_id = s.equipment_id AND bh.timestamp_utc = s.timestamp_utc
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
),
prior AS (
  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch
  FROM sensor_rows
),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment
  FROM prior
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM prior_groups WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT valid.*
  FROM valid
),
signals AS (
  SELECT windowed.*,
    CASE WHEN next_epoch IS NULL OR next_epoch <= epoch_seconds THEN 0.0
         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS dt_seconds,
    CAST(CASE WHEN ((energized = 1 AND ((sensor_role = 'oa_t' AND (value < (1.666667 - 52.777778 * 1) OR value > (1.666667 + 52.777778 * 1))) OR (sensor_role = 'mat' AND (value < (7.222222 - 36.111111 * 1) OR value > (7.222222 + 36.111111 * 1))) OR (sensor_role = 'zone_t' AND (value < (21.111111 - 16.666667 * 1) OR value > (21.111111 + 16.666667 * 1))) OR (sensor_role = 'rat' AND (value < (21.111111 - 16.666667 * 1) OR value > (21.111111 + 16.666667 * 1))) OR (sensor_role = 'sat' AND (value < (32.222222 - 33.333333 * 1) OR value > (32.222222 + 33.333333 * 1))) OR (sensor_role = 'chw_supply_t' AND (value < (12.777778 - 13.888889 * 1) OR value > (12.777778 + 13.888889 * 1))) OR (sensor_role = 'chw_return_t' AND (value < (15.555556 - 16.666667 * 1) OR value > (15.555556 + 16.666667 * 1))) OR (sensor_role = 'hw_supply_t' AND (value < (54.444444 - 50.0 * 1) OR value > (54.444444 + 50.0 * 1))) OR (sensor_role = 'hw_return_t' AND (value < (54.444444 - 50.0 * 1) OR value > (54.444444 + 50.0 * 1))) OR (sensor_role = 'oa_h' AND (value < (50.0 - 50.0 * 1) OR value > (50.0 + 50.0 * 1))) OR (sensor_role = 'ra_h' AND (value < (50.0 - 50.0 * 1) OR value > (50.0 + 50.0 * 1))) OR (sensor_role = 'zone_rh' AND (value < (50.0 - 50.0 * 1) OR value > (50.0 + 50.0 * 1))) OR (sensor_role = 'ma_h' AND (value < (50.0 - 50.0 * 1) OR value > (50.0 + 50.0 * 1))) OR (sensor_role = 'sa_h' AND (value < (50.0 - 50.0 * 1) OR value > (50.0 + 50.0 * 1))) OR (sensor_role = 'duct_static' AND (value < (870.94 - 1119.78 * 1) OR value > (870.94 + 1119.78 * 1)))))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM windowed
),
segments AS (
  SELECT signals.*,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds <= 0 THEN 0.0
         WHEN dt_seconds < 1800 THEN dt_seconds
         ELSE 1800 END AS normal_seconds,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds > 1800
         THEN dt_seconds - 1800 ELSE 0.0 END AS silence_seconds
  FROM signals
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_raw_fault
  FROM segments
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_group
  FROM lagged segments
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT streak_groups.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 THEN normal_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment, streak_group
      ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS fault_streak_seconds
  FROM streak_groups
),
confirmed_rows AS (
  SELECT streaks.*,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND fault_streak_seconds >= 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS normal_confirmed
  FROM streaks
),
final AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch,
    normal_confirmed AS confirmed, normal_seconds AS held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE normal_seconds > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role,
    epoch_seconds + 1800 AS segment_epoch,
    1 AS confirmed, silence_seconds AS held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE silence_seconds > 0
),
scored AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role,
    SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
    SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
)
SELECT ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id, ss.sensor_role,
  COALESCE(scored.fault_hours, 0.0) AS fault_hours,
  COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) AS covered_hours
FROM sensor_series ss
LEFT JOIN scored USING (equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role)
ORDER BY ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id;
```

</details>


### SV-RATE {#sv-rate}

Context-aware sensor rate of change

**Priority** P0 · **Equipment** `ahu`, `vav`, `chiller`, `boiler`, `weather`, `zone_other`, `heatpump` · **Confirm** 10 min · **Parity** [known divergence](parity.html#sv-rate) · [pandas twin](pandas-cookbook.html#sv-rate)

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | NF class | SI unit | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `oa_t` | outside-air-temp | `outside-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |
| `mat` | mixed-air-temp | `mixed-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |
| `zone_t` | zone-air-temp | `zone-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |
| `rat` | return-air-temp | `return-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |
| `sat` | discharge-air-temp | `discharge-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 10 | 0 | 60 | 5 | min |
| `max_gap_hours` | Max sample gap | 1 | 0.1 | 12 | 0.1 | h |
| `persistence_min` † | Fault persistence | 10 | 5 | 60 | 1 | min |
| `sensor_span` | Sensor span | 100 | 1 | 500 | 1 | signal units |
| `steady_fault_per_hour` | Steady-state slew limit | 3.33333 | 0.555556 | 33.3333 | 0.277778 | Δ°C/h |

† informational: this control has no effect in the SQL template.

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `series_id`, `sensor_role`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (126 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/sv_rate.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Sensor-series input and output are keyed by the bound point UUID, not the role.
WITH base_proof AS (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN h.fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.zone_flow IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.zone_flow > 23.597350 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.pump_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.pump_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.chw_pump_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.chw_pump_cmd > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.chiller_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.chiller_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1 END AS energized
  FROM history h
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
sensor_rows AS (
  SELECT s.equipment_id, s.series_id, s.sensor_role, s.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    CASE WHEN s.sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat')
      THEN fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) ELSE NULL END AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
),
prior AS (
  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch
  FROM sensor_rows
),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL
                  OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > 1 * 3600.0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment
  FROM prior
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM prior_groups WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
rates AS (
  SELECT valid.*,
    (epoch_seconds - previous_epoch) / 3600.0 AS dt_hours,
    ABS(value - previous_value) AS delta
  FROM valid
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT rates.*,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > 1 * 3600.0 THEN 0
      WHEN dt_hours IS NULL OR dt_hours <= 0.0 THEN 0
      WHEN delta / dt_hours > (3.333333 * 100 / 100.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS over_rate
  FROM rates
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT flagged.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(over_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_over_rate
  FROM flagged
),
base AS (
  SELECT lagged.*,
    CAST(CASE WHEN over_rate = 1 AND previous_over_rate = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    CASE WHEN next_epoch IS NULL OR next_epoch <= epoch_seconds THEN 0.0
         WHEN next_epoch - epoch_seconds > 1 * 3600.0 THEN 0.0
         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS held_seconds
  FROM lagged
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT base.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_raw_fault
  FROM base
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT streak_groups.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_group
  FROM streak_groups
),
confirmed_rows AS (
  SELECT streaks.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment, streak_group
      ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS fault_streak_seconds
  FROM streaks
),
final AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND fault_streak_seconds >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed,
    held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE held_seconds > 0
),
scored AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role,
    SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
    SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
)
SELECT ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id, ss.sensor_role,
  COALESCE(scored.fault_hours, 0.0) AS fault_hours,
  COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) AS covered_hours
FROM sensor_series ss
LEFT JOIN scored USING (equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role)
ORDER BY ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id;
```

</details>


### SV-SPIKE {#sv-spike}

**Priority** P0 · **Equipment** `ahu`, `vav`, `chiller`, `boiler`, `weather`, `zone_other`, `heatpump` · **Confirm** 5 min · **Parity** [match](parity.html#sv-spike) · [pandas twin](pandas-cookbook.html#sv-spike)

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | NF class | SI unit | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `mat` | mixed-air-temp | `mixed-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |
| `zone_t` | zone-air-temp | `zone-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |
| `rat` | return-air-temp | `return-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |
| `sat` | discharge-air-temp | `discharge-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |

| `pump_status` | pump-status | - | 0/1 | optional |

| `zone_flow` | zone-airflow | `discharge-air-flow-sensor`, `air-flow-sensor` | L/s | optional |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 5 | 0 | 60 | 5 | min |
| `max_silence_hours` | Max sensor silence | 0.5 | 0.25 | 12 | 0.25 | h |
| `minimum_active_coverage_pct` | Min active coverage | 5 | 0 | 100 | 1 | % |
| `require_operational_gate` | Require operational gate | 1 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0/1 |
| `spike_scale` † | Spike limit scale (global) | 1 | 0.25 | 3 | 0.25 | × (scale) |
| `spike_scale_humidity` | Spike scale humidity | 1 | 0.25 | 4 | 0.25 | × (scale) |
| `spike_scale_pressure` | Spike scale pressure | 1 | 0.25 | 4 | 0.25 | × (scale) |
