**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `series_id`, `sensor_role`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (131 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/sv_spike.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
WITH base_proof AS (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN h.fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.zone_flow IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.zone_flow > 23.597350 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.pump_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.pump_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.chw_pump_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.chw_pump_cmd > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.chiller_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.chiller_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1 END AS energized
  FROM history h
),
base_history AS (
  SELECT base_proof.*,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
sensor_rows AS (
  SELECT s.equipment_id, s.series_id, s.sensor_role, s.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    COALESCE(bh.energized, 1) AS energized,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    CASE WHEN s.sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'duct_static')
      THEN fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) ELSE NULL END AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN base_history bh
    ON bh.equipment_id = s.equipment_id AND bh.timestamp_utc = s.timestamp_utc
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
),
prior AS (
  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch
  FROM sensor_rows
),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment
  FROM prior
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM prior_groups WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT valid.*
  FROM valid
),
signals AS (
  SELECT windowed.*,
    CASE WHEN next_epoch IS NULL OR next_epoch <= epoch_seconds THEN 0.0
         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS dt_seconds,
    CAST(CASE WHEN (((1 < 0.5 OR (energized = 1 AND coverage_pct >= 5)) AND ((sensor_role = 'oa_t' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 20.0 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'mat' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 13.888889 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'zone_t' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 6.666667 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'rat' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 6.666667 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'sat' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 22.222222 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'chw_supply_t' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 11.111111 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'chw_return_t' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 11.111111 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'hw_supply_t' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 33.333333 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'hw_return_t' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 33.333333 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'oa_h' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 25.0 * 1) OR (sensor_role = 'duct_static' AND previous_value IS NOT NULL AND epoch_seconds - previous_epoch <= 1800 AND ABS(value - previous_value) > 497.68 * 1)))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM windowed
),
segments AS (
  SELECT signals.*,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds <= 0 THEN 0.0
         WHEN dt_seconds < 1800 THEN dt_seconds
         ELSE 1800 END AS normal_seconds,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds > 1800
         THEN dt_seconds - 1800 ELSE 0.0 END AS silence_seconds
  FROM signals
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_raw_fault
  FROM segments
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_group
  FROM lagged segments
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT streak_groups.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 THEN normal_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment, streak_group
      ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS fault_streak_seconds
  FROM streak_groups
),
confirmed_rows AS (
  SELECT streaks.*,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND fault_streak_seconds >= 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS normal_confirmed
  FROM streaks
),
final AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch,
    normal_confirmed AS confirmed, normal_seconds AS held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE normal_seconds > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role,
    epoch_seconds + 1800 AS segment_epoch,
    1 AS confirmed, silence_seconds AS held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE silence_seconds > 0
),
scored AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role,
    SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
    SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
)
SELECT ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id, ss.sensor_role,
  COALESCE(scored.fault_hours, 0.0) AS fault_hours,
  COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) AS covered_hours
FROM sensor_series ss
LEFT JOIN scored USING (equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role)
ORDER BY ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id;
```

</details>


### SV-STALE {#sv-stale}

Stale data (no fresh samples)

**Priority** P0 · **Equipment** `ahu`, `vav`, `chiller`, `boiler`, `weather`, `zone_other`, `heatpump` · **Confirm** 5 min · **Parity** [match](parity.html#sv-stale) · [pandas twin](pandas-cookbook.html#sv-stale)

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | NF class | SI unit | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `oa_t` | outside-air-temp | `outside-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |
| `mat` | mixed-air-temp | `mixed-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |
| `zone_t` | zone-air-temp | `zone-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |
| `rat` | return-air-temp | `return-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |
| `sat` | discharge-air-temp | `discharge-air-temp-sensor` | °C | optional |
| `chw_supply_t` | chilled-water-supply-temp | - | °C | optional |
| `chw_return_t` | chilled-water-return-temp | - | °C | optional |
| `hw_supply_t` | hot-water-supply-temp | - | °C | optional |
| `hw_return_t` | hot-water-return-temp | - | °C | optional |
| `oa_h` | outside-air-humidity | `outside-air-humidity-sensor` | % | optional |
| `ra_h` | return-air-humidity | `return-air-humidity-sensor` | % | optional |
| `zone_rh` | zone-air-humidity | `zone-air-humidity-sensor` | % | optional |
| `ma_h` | mixed-air-humidity | `mixed-air-humidity-sensor` | % | optional |
| `sa_h` | supply-air-humidity | `discharge-air-humidity-sensor` | % | optional |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 5 | 0 | 60 | 5 | min |
| `max_silence_hours` | Max sensor silence | 0.5 | 0.25 | 12 | 0.25 | h |
| `stale_hours` | Stale window | 2 | 0.25 | 12 | 0.25 | h |
| `stale_tol` | Stale tolerance | 0.027778 | 0 | 0.555556 | 0.005556 | °C |

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `series_id`, `sensor_role`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (155 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/sv_stale.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
WITH base_proof AS (
  SELECT h.*,
    CASE
      WHEN h.fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.zone_flow IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.zone_flow > 23.597350 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.pump_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.pump_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.chw_pump_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.chw_pump_cmd > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.chiller_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.chiller_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1 END AS energized
  FROM history h
),
base_history AS (
  SELECT base_proof.*,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
sensor_rows AS (
  SELECT s.equipment_id, s.series_id, s.sensor_role, s.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    COALESCE(bh.energized, 1) AS energized,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    CASE WHEN s.sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'chw_supply_t', 'chw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'hw_return_t', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'zone_rh', 'ma_h', 'sa_h')
      THEN fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) ELSE NULL END AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN base_history bh
    ON bh.equipment_id = s.equipment_id AND bh.timestamp_utc = s.timestamp_utc
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
),
prior AS (
  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch
  FROM sensor_rows
),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > 1800 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment
  FROM prior
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM prior_groups WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT valid.*,
    MIN(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_first_epoch,
    MIN(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_min,
    MAX(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_max,
    FIRST_VALUE(previous_value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_first_prev_value,
    FIRST_VALUE(previous_epoch) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_first_prev_epoch
  FROM valid
),
segments0 AS (
  SELECT windowed.*,
    MIN(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment) AS segment_start_epoch
  FROM windowed
),
elapsed_window AS (
  SELECT segments0.*,
    CASE WHEN window_first_epoch > epoch_seconds - 7200
           AND window_first_prev_epoch <= epoch_seconds - 7200
           AND window_first_prev_epoch >= segment_start_epoch
           AND window_first_prev_value < window_min
         THEN window_first_prev_value ELSE window_min END AS elapsed_window_min,
    CASE WHEN window_first_epoch > epoch_seconds - 7200
           AND window_first_prev_epoch <= epoch_seconds - 7200
           AND window_first_prev_epoch >= segment_start_epoch
           AND window_first_prev_value > window_max
         THEN window_first_prev_value ELSE window_max END AS elapsed_window_max
  FROM segments0
),
signals AS (
  SELECT elapsed_window.*,
    CASE WHEN next_epoch IS NULL OR next_epoch <= epoch_seconds THEN 0.0
         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS dt_seconds,
    CAST(CASE WHEN (((segment_start_epoch <= epoch_seconds - 7200) AND (elapsed_window_max - elapsed_window_min <= CASE WHEN sensor_role IN ('oa_h','ra_h','zone_rh','ma_h','sa_h') THEN 0.05 ELSE 0.027778 END))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM elapsed_window
),
segments AS (
  SELECT signals.*,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds <= 0 THEN 0.0
         WHEN dt_seconds < 1800 THEN dt_seconds
         ELSE 1800 END AS normal_seconds,
    CASE WHEN dt_seconds > 1800
         THEN dt_seconds - 1800 ELSE 0.0 END AS silence_seconds
  FROM signals
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_raw_fault
  FROM segments
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT segments.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_group
  FROM lagged segments
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT streak_groups.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 THEN normal_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment, streak_group
      ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS fault_streak_seconds
  FROM streak_groups
),
confirmed_rows AS (
  SELECT streaks.*,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND fault_streak_seconds >= 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS normal_confirmed
  FROM streaks
),
final AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch,
    normal_confirmed AS confirmed, normal_seconds AS held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE normal_seconds > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role,
    epoch_seconds + 1800 AS segment_epoch,
    1 AS confirmed, silence_seconds AS held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE silence_seconds > 0
),
scored AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role,
    SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
    SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours
  FROM final
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
)
SELECT ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id, ss.sensor_role,
  COALESCE(scored.fault_hours, 0.0) AS fault_hours,
  COALESCE(scored.covered_hours, 0.0) AS covered_hours
FROM sensor_series ss
LEFT JOIN scored USING (equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role)
ORDER BY ss.equipment_id, ss.series_id;
```

</details>


## Weather {#group-weather}

Web weather versus the site's own outside air sensor.


### OAT-METEO {#oat-meteo}

Equipment OAT vs weather-staged wx OAT

**Priority** P0 · **Equipment** `ahu` · **Confirm** 15 min · **Parity** [known divergence](parity.html#oat-meteo) · [pandas twin](pandas-cookbook.html#oat-meteo)

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | NF class | SI unit | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `oa_t` | outside-air-temp | `outside-air-temp-sensor` | °C | required |
| `web_oa_t` | web-outside-air-temp | - | °C | optional |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 15 | 0 | 60 | 5 | min |
| `oat_err` | OAT vs meteo tolerance | 2.77778 | 1.11111 | 11.1111 | 0.277778 | °C |
| `web_asof_margin_seconds` | Web as-of margin | 300 | 0 | 1800 | 60 | s |
| `web_cadence_seconds` | Web weather cadence | 1200 | 300 | 7200 | 300 | s |

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`, `fault_pct`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (133 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/oat_meteo_fault.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- oat_meteo_fault.sql — BAS OAT vs meteo reference (|Δ| > threshold) + confirm
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): oa_t and the web reference are °C; OAT_ERR is a temperature difference in K.
-- Web weather is joined as-of: carry the last web sample forward up to
-- WEB_ASOF_BOUND_SECONDS (web cadence + margin from registry). Beyond that bound
-- the local sample is not compared (not-assessed seconds, never a no-fault).
-- Prefer equipment web_oa_t (matches the reference oracle); fall back to weather rows when absent.
-- Targeting is registry equipment_kinds (ahu) plus the package stamp applied
-- after this query. This file does not filter equipment_id by prefix or LIKE.
WITH web_points AS (
  SELECT timestamp_utc, web_oa_t AS ref_val
  FROM weather
  WHERE web_oa_t IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp_utc, web_oa_t AS ref_val
  FROM history
  WHERE web_oa_t IS NOT NULL
),
web_dedup AS (
  SELECT timestamp_utc, MAX(ref_val) AS ref_val
  FROM web_points
  GROUP BY timestamp_utc
),
web_intervals AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc AS ref_ts,
    ref_val,
    LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) AS next_ref_ts
  FROM web_dedup
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    h.oa_t,
    CAST(wi.ref_ts AS timestamptz) AS ref_ts,
    CAST(wi.ref_val AS double precision) AS ref_oa_t,
    CASE
      WHEN h.oa_t IS NULL THEN false
      WHEN wi.ref_val IS NULL THEN false
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (h.timestamp_utc - wi.ref_ts)) > 1500
      THEN false
      ELSE true
    END AS assessable
  FROM history h
  LEFT JOIN web_intervals wi
    ON h.timestamp_utc >= wi.ref_ts
   AND (wi.next_ref_ts IS NULL OR h.timestamp_utc < wi.next_ref_ts)
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    assessable,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN NOT assessable THEN NULL
      WHEN ABS(oa_t - ref_oa_t) > 2.777778 THEN 1
      ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM joined
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT assessable THEN 0.0
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT assessable THEN 1
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
       AND COALESCE(LAG(assessable) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), false)
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN assessable AND raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>


### WX-1 {#wx-1}

OA temperature spike

**Priority** P0 · **Equipment** `weather` · **Confirm** 5 min · **Parity** [match](parity.html#wx-1) · [pandas twin](pandas-cookbook.html#wx-1)

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | NF class | SI unit | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `oa_t` | outside-air-temp | `outside-air-temp-sensor` | °C | required |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` | Fault confirm delay | 5 | 0 | 60 | 5 | min |
| `spike_limit` | Spike limit | 8.88889 | 2.22222 | 22.2222 | 0.555556 | °C |

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`, `fault_pct`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (91 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/wx1_oa_spike.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- wx1_oa_spike.sql — OA temperature spike
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): oa_t is °C and SPIKE_LIMIT is a temperature difference in K.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    oa_t,
    LAG(oa_t) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) AS prev_oa_t
  FROM history
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN oa_t IS NULL OR prev_oa_t IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN ABS(oa_t - prev_oa_t) > 8.888889 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>

### FAN-RUNTIME-HOURS {#fan-runtime-hours}

Fan running hours where fan_cmd > 5% (normalized 0-1)

**Priority** P0 · **Equipment** any equipment · **Confirm** immediate · **Parity** [SQL only](parity.html#fan-runtime-hours) · SQL only (no pandas twin)

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | NF class | SI unit | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fan_cmd` | fan-cmd | `discharge-run-cmd`, `run-cmd` | % | required |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` † | Fault confirm delay | 0 | 0 | 120 | 1 | min |

† informational: this control has no effect in the SQL template.

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `fan_runtime_hours`, `total_hours`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (35 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/fan_runtime_hours.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fan_runtime_hours.sql
-- Fan runtime integrates the forward delta while fan_cmd > 0.05.
-- A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown and is omitted from both totals.
-- The last sample does not invent a trailing interval.

WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    fan_cmd AS fan_cmd,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    fan_cmd,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.05 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fan_runtime_hours,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS total_hours
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>


### FAULT-ELAPSED-HOURS {#fault-elapsed-hours}

Comfort fault sample count → hours

**Priority** P0 · **Equipment** any equipment · **Confirm** immediate · **Parity** [SQL only](parity.html#fault-elapsed-hours) · SQL only (no pandas twin)

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | NF class | SI unit | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `zone_t` | zone-air-temp | `zone-air-temp-sensor` | °C | required |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` † | Fault confirm delay | 0 | 0 | 120 | 1 | min |
| `zone_t_hi` | Zone comfort high | 24.4444 | 22.2222 | 29.4444 | 0.277778 | °C |
| `zone_t_lo` | Zone comfort low | 20 | 15.5556 | 22.2222 | 0.277778 | °C |

† informational: this control has no effect in the SQL template.

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `fault_samples`, `fault_hours`, `covered_hours`, `fault_pct`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (42 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/fault_elapsed_hours.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fault_elapsed_hours.sql — comfort fault elapsed rollup
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): zone_t and ZONE_T_LO / ZONE_T_HI are °C.
-- Out-of-band zone temperature holds forward until the next sample.
-- Gaps longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS are unknown (not fault, not covered).
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_t,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE zone_t IS NOT NULL
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_t,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN zone_t < 20 OR zone_t > 24.444444 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fault_samples,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN zone_t < 20 OR zone_t > 24.444444 THEN held_seconds
    ELSE 0.0
  END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE
    WHEN zone_t < 20 OR zone_t > 24.444444 THEN held_seconds
    ELSE 0.0
  END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>


### ZONE-COMFORT-PCT {#zone-comfort-pct}

Percent of samples in comfort band

**Priority** P0 · **Equipment** any equipment · **Confirm** immediate · **Parity** [SQL only](parity.html#zone-comfort-pct) · SQL only (no pandas twin)

**Inputs**

| Role (SQL column) | Haystack role | NF class | SI unit | Needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `zone_t` | zone-air-temp | `zone-air-temp-sensor` | °C | required |

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Label | Default | Min | Max | Step | SI unit |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `confirm_min` † | Fault confirm delay | 0 | 0 | 120 | 1 | min |
| `zone_t_hi` | Zone comfort high | 24.4444 | 22.2222 | 29.4444 | 0.277778 | °C |
| `zone_t_lo` | Zone comfort low | 20 | 15.5556 | 22.2222 | 0.277778 | °C |

† informational: this control has no effect in the SQL template.

**Output columns**: `equipment_id`, `comfort_pct`

<details markdown="1">
<summary>SQL at defaults (35 lines) · <a href="https://github.com/bbartling/open-fdd/blob/master/sql/fdd/postgres/rules/zone_comfort_pct.sql">template file</a></summary>

```sql
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- zone_comfort_pct.sql
-- Comfort is the share of eligible elapsed time inside the band, not a row count.
-- Band placeholders ZONE_T_LO / ZONE_T_HI and history zone_t are SI °C (metric pack).
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_t,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE zone_t IS NOT NULL
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_t,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE
    WHEN zone_t >= 20 AND zone_t <= 24.444444444 THEN held_seconds
    ELSE 0.0
  END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS comfort_pct
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;
```

</details>
